corrections.reason: In Mark 3:11, the canonical Ge'ez verb with 3rd person plural object suffix is አኀዞሙ ('possessed them', translated in L30 as ያደሩባቸው), which is clearly printed on the page; Stage 1 misread ዞሙ as ዙነ.
The printed Fidel is 1st-order በ (በአኔርጌስ), matching the repetition at the start of the next page.
